rows.en: The Giant Devil's appeared! It's running wild in the city!
So the Giant Devil has been completed!?
Then… what about Rieko and Misao and the others!?
They must be held prisoner in the Shadow base!
We have to rescue them…
Right, you lot…

…!?

You… who are you?
Apfaron!?

Heh heh heh…

Well, well… It seems everyone's here. Pardon me for intruding…
Waltzing right in here like this… that's just like you, isn't it?

That was a splendid fight, Lucifard! And the rest of you as well…

Today… there's something I simply must let you all know.

And so I came all the way to this filthy little place.
Well, sorry it's so filthy! Hey, don't just sit down without asking!
Our mothership, the Space Fortress Naager, is already near Mars!

The TDF's survey craft should confirm its presence soon enough…

Heh heh heh… I can just picture you all running around in a panic at the appearance of an unknown giant space fortress! Heh heh… Hahahaha!
You bastard…

Don't be hasty… The time for our duel has not yet come!

But… with this, our groundwork is complete.

From now on… we will carry out the "Gaia Project" exactly as our great Steel Emperor Zephas intends!

Be ready, Lucifard! Far beyond anything your power can reach, the Earth will sink into a planet filled with terror and chaos…
What!? Apfaron! What's this "Gaia Project"?

Now then… It seems I've overstayed my welcome.

Mr. Tachibana… next time I come by, do treat me to a cup of coffee at least.

And now, everyone… good day.
H-hold it! Apfaron!
He vanished…

…!?

Hey, you lot! Pull yourselves together!

The mastermind just declared war on us! Shape up!
Damn it… Oyassan, we're heading out!

Right, I'm counting on you!

Taki! You're just out of your sickbed, so you stay here!
Wha… Oyassan!
Heh heh… Still, isn't it great? Taki's back on his feet…
So that's… the Giant Devil?
It's enormous… That thing's an android?
Heh heh heh… Think you can beat me? The real surprises are still to come.

Security squad, arriving now! Engaging the Giant Devil…

What is that thing…? That's the Giant Devil?
Ms. Kitakura, be careful! We have no idea what abilities it has!

Taaah!

Ohohohohoho…
Bijinder!? Mari!

Taaah!

That's Bijinder (Shadow)! It isn't me!
Two Bijinders?

Heh heh heh… It seems the whole cast is here.

Rampage, Giant Devil! Destroy, Giant Devil! Hahaha…
That trumpet…? It can't be! Zero-One should be dead!
Search! Search!
There he is! Over there!

…!?

Kikaider! You're alive!?
Shadow Knight!

I saw through that "Akira" being an android from how fast he sank to the bottom of the sea!

Kikaider won't fall for your traps!

But… this trumpet is my brother's trumpet! What did you do to my brother!? I won't forgive you!

Nngh… Damn you, Kikaider!

…!?
You're alive too!?
Hahaha…

A cheap trick like that won't kill me!

Shadow Knight! Did you forget I can fly faster than an explosion spreads!?
Brother!
Jiro!

The Giant Devil is already up and running!

We can't lose this fight, if only to save Rieko and the others! Let's go!
Lord Zero-One! Have at you!
Wait, Waruder! I don't have time to fight you right now!
Wait, Waruder! I don't have time to fight you right now!
Silence, Zero-One! Prepare yourself! Here I come!
Hahaha… Waruder! I'll be your opponent!
Two Waruders…?
Two Waruders…?

Heh heh heh… Now it's getting interesting!

Shadow Bijinder, Shadow Waruder, finish off Zero-One and the rest! Hahaha…
Misao… Take these kids and run!
What are you talking about!? "Run," she says… How are we supposed to get out?
Hyaah…!
Ah… Big sister…!
Whoa… She broke the iron bars!

I've kept it a secret from everyone until now, but…

I'm an android too, just like Ichiro and the others…!
Eh…!?

My abilities are nothing compared to Ichiro's and the others', but…

Now, run! Hurry…!
What about you…? Why aren't you coming with us?

This isn't just an ordinary bomb!

When it explodes… it's rigged to flood the whole base with poison gas!

I'll stay here and draw the Shadowmen's attention! Misao, get as far away as you can…

Now… hurry, before they find you!
All right! Then… Rieko, I'm counting on you.
Big sisteeeer!

Nngh… The Giant Devil has been destroyed!

But the blueprints of Hiroshi and Akira are in our Shadow's hands!

If we so desire, the Giant Devil can be rebuilt as many times as we like!

The Ten-Million-Person Murder Plan… To complete this plan, we have already killed 5,368 humans…

I am far from giving up on my ambition of world conquest!
Waruder! Rieko sacrificed herself because of you!
What!? Zero-One, is that true!?
Waruder… It was you who handed Akira over to Shadow, wasn't it?

…!? I never meant…

No, there is no excuse… If Lady Rieko died because of it, the responsibility is mine!

Laugh at me, Lady Bijinder… Just once… just once I wished to be a friend to a child…

I wished to taste for myself the happiness of being loved by children, as you and Lord Zero-One are!

But, Waruder… you handed that very Akira over to Shadow!

As a result… the Giant Devil was completed, and Rieko sacrificed herself to save everyone…

Lady Bijinder…

Letting Akira see Lady Rieko, whom he so longed to see… was that good? Or was it evil…? That is what I cannot understand!

If only I could tell good from evil… Lady Rieko need not have died!
Waruder, you…
I take my leave of you here…
Mari! I've been looking for you!

uncertain: U10019: narration-kind row is a reported line with no speaker (page 1 seems lost); written as speech.
U10024-U10025: Tobei's line cut off by Apfaron's arrival; the second row is narration-kind but continues the speech.
U10029/U10034: Apfaron addresses [HERO2] as "Lucifard"; kept as written.
U10034: ［ガイア計両］ read as ガイア計画 "Gaia Project"; full-width brackets replaced with double quotes.
U10047: Chief Kitakura uses feminine speech here (なの); "Ms. Kitakura" used in U10048 on that basis.
U10054/U10059: ペット read as slang for trumpet (Ichiro's trumpet).
U10058-U10059 and U10062-U10063: speeches split by a narration-kind continuation row; split kept.
U10085: "draw the Shadowmen's attention" - plural from context.
U10088: 1000百人殺人計両 read as 1000万人殺人計画 "Ten-Million-Person Murder Plan"; 百 appears to be a misread of 万 (cf. B0131 U10490 6百5000メートル = 65,000 m).
U10093: ご貴殿やゼロワン殿 as "you and Lord Zero-One".

new_names.why: Naager plan name, not in glossary
UCMA unit term, not in glossary
